rules.name: grasa-drift-inputs-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT security_id, value_date AS legacy_cache_date, opt_type, maturity, strike, strike1, vol1_id, p1_settleprice, p1_vol, rf_rate1, p1_div_yield, tick_size, barrier1_level, barrier1_rebate, isbarrier1breached FROM dbsystemuat.input_security_settlement_value_cache_table_cfs WHERE value_date = (SELECT MAX(value_date) FROM dbsystemuat.input_security_settlement_value_cache_table_cfs) AND security_id IN ( SELECT security_id FROM dbsystemuat.helper_sensitivity_report_view_cache_table_cfs WHERE (SUBSTRING(contract_number, 1, 3) = 'ACM' AND product_code = 'CM CT') OR (SUBSTRING(contract_number, 1, 3) = 'IOL' AND product_code = 'CM BO') OR (SUBSTRING(contract_number, 1, 3) = 'PGE' AND product_code = 'CM S'))

WITH vd AS (SELECT tenant_id, value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), sec AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT c.security_id FROM opera.helper_sensitivity_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND upper(trim(c.business_unit)) = :bu AND ((upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) = 'ACM' AND upper(trim(c.product_code)) = 'CM CT') OR (upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) = 'IOL' AND upper(trim(c.product_code)) = 'CM BO') OR (upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) = 'PGE' AND upper(trim(c.product_code)) = 'CM S'))) SELECT DISTINCT si.security_id, si.derivative_type AS opt_type, si.maturity_date AS maturity, si.strike, si.strike1, si.vol1_id, u1.settle_value AS p1_settleprice, CASE WHEN cv.p1_vol > 0 THEN cv.p1_vol WHEN shared_cv.p1_vol > 0 THEN shared_cv.p1_vol ELSE sv.settle_vol END AS p1_vol, u1.risk_free_rate AS rf_rate1, u1.div_yield AS p1_div_yield, pm.tick_size, si.barrier1_level, si.barrier1_rebate, bm.isbarrier1_breached AS isbarrier1breached FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table si JOIN vd ON true LEFT JOIN opera.underlying_settle_value_table u1 ON u1.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND u1.underlying_id = si.underlying1_id AND u1.value_date = vd.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.derivative_type_call_put_id_mapping_table cpm ON upper(cpm.derivative_type) = upper(si.derivative_type) LEFT JOIN opera.settlement_vol_surf_table sv ON sv.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND sv.vol_id = si.vol1_id AND sv.strike = si.strike1 AND sv.value_date = vd.value_date AND upper(sv.call_put_id) = upper(cpm.call_put_id) LEFT JOIN opera.underlying_list_table ul ON ul.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND ul.underlying_id = si.underlying1_id LEFT JOIN opera.product_master_table pm ON pm.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND pm.invenio_product_code = ul.invenio_product_code LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT max(b.isbarrier1_breached) AS isbarrier1_breached FROM opera.barrier_monitoring_table b WHERE b.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND b.business_unit = si.business_unit AND b.security_id = si.security_id AND b.value_date <= vd.value_date) bm ON true LEFT JOIN opera.calculated_settle_vol_table cv ON cv.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND upper(cv.business_unit) = :bu AND cv.security_id = si.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.calculated_settle_vol_table shared_cv ON shared_cv.tenant_id IS NULL AND upper(shared_cv.business_unit) = :bu AND shared_cv.security_id = si.security_id WHERE si.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND upper(si.business_unit) = :bu AND si.security_id IN (SELECT security_id FROM sec)
